title: Broccoli and White Bean Pasta Salad with Basil Pesto
changes_from_base: A lemony basil and pine-nut pesto dresses the pasta, and blanched broccoli and cannellini beans replace the mozzarella and olives. Dairy-free.
summary: Gemelli, crisp-tender broccoli and creamy cannellini beans tossed in a lemony basil and pine-nut pesto with sweet cherry tomatoes. Dairy-free.

ingredients.item: fine salt for 4 litres of pasta water (1%)
ingredients.note: about 6.75 tsp; most of it goes down the drain

ingredients.item: broccoli, florets cut small and stalk peeled and sliced
fine sea salt or table salt
canned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed (one 400 g tin)
extra toasted pine nuts, to finish

steps.title: Blanch the broccoli
steps.text: Bring the salted water to the boil, add the broccoli for 90 sec, then lift it into iced water with a slotted spoon. Drain well.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Cook the pasta in the same water until just past al dente, drain, rinse cold and shake dry.

steps.title: Make the pesto
steps.text: Blend the basil, nuts, garlic, lemon and salt, then the oil, to a loose purée.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Toss the pasta, broccoli, beans and tomatoes with the pesto and finish with the extra nuts.

tips: Cut the broccoli small so it blanches evenly in 90 seconds.
The iced water keeps the broccoli bright green.
Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan and watch them closely; they burn fast.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; loosen with a splash of water or oil and check the seasoning before serving. Not suitable for freezing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
